rows.text_en: Military Manpower Administration ( Innovation and Performance Officer ), 042-481-2647
Chapter 1 General Provisions

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 병무청과 그 소속기관에 두는 보조기관ㆍ보좌기관의 직급 및 직급별 정원,「정부조직법」 제2조제3항 및 제5항에 따라 국장 밑에 두는 보조기관과 이에 상당하는 보좌기관의 설치 및 사무분장 등 「병무청과 그 소속기관 직제」에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to define matters delegated by the “Organization of the Military Manpower Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies” and matters necessary for its implementation, such as the ranks and staffing quotas for auxiliary and advisory agencies established within the Military Manpower Administration and its affiliated agencies, the establishment of auxiliary agencies placed under a director pursuant to Article 2 , Paragraphs 3 and 5 of the “Government Organization Act” and advisory agencies equivalent thereto, and the division of duties.
Chapter 2 Military Manpower Administration

rows.source_ko: 제2조(차장) 차장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다. <개정 2013. 12. 24.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Deputy Administrator) The Deputy Minister shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A. <Amended Dec. 24, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(대변인) 대변인은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2009. 4. 8., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Spokesperson) The Spokesperson shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary. <Amended Apr. 8, 2009; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제4조(감사담당관) 감사담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Audit Officer) The Audit Officer shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제5조(기획조정관) ① 기획조정관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Director General of Planning and Coordination) ① The Director General of Planning and Coordination shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008>

rows.text_en: ② The Central Military Service Examination Center shall establish an Examination Support Division and a Military Service Judgment Examination Division; the heads of each division shall be appointed from among Medical Technology Officers, Computer Science Officers, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officers, or Administrative Officers. <Amended Oct. 4, 2013; Feb. 22, 2022; Dec. 30, 2022; Aug. 30, 2023; Dec. 31, 2024>
③ The Head of the Examination Support Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 8, 2011; Dec. 30, 2022; Dec. 31, 2024>
1. General Affairs, Documents, Security, Personnel, and Official Seal Management
2. Matters concerning budget, accounting, and supplies
3. Establishment of plans for psychological testing and clinical pathology/radiology examinations
4. Conduct psychological tests and clinical pathology and imaging tests
5. Maintenance and Management of Military Service Examination Equipment

rows.source_ko: 6. 심리검사 및 임상병리ㆍ영상의학검사와 관련한 자료 등 기록ㆍ유지 및 관리
rows.text_en: 6. Recording, maintenance, and management of data, etc. related to psychological tests and clinical pathology and imaging tests

rows.source_ko: 7. 심리검사 및 임상병리ㆍ영상의학검사 관련 의료기술 분야 교육에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning education in the field of medical technology related to psychological testing and clinical pathology and imaging tests

rows.source_ko: 8. 그 밖에 중앙병역판정검사소의 운영을 위한 행정사무와 병무청장이 지정하는 심리검사 및 임상병리ㆍ영상의학검사에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Other administrative affairs for the operation of the Central Military Service Examination Center and matters concerning psychological examinations and clinical pathology and imaging examinations designated by the Commissioner of the Military Manpower Administration
④ The Head of the Military Service Judgment Examination Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 8, 2011; Nov. 29, 2016; Dec. 30, 2022; Dec. 31, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 지방병무청장이 신체검사 및 심리검사를 의뢰한 자의 신체등급 판정 사무에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the determination of physical grades for persons referred for physical and psychological examinations by the Head of the Regional Military Manpower Administration

rows.source_ko: 1의2. 신체검사(임상병리ㆍ영상의학검사는 제외한다. 이하 이 항에서 같다) 계획의 수립
rows.text_en: 1-2. Establishment of a plan for physical examinations (excluding clinical pathology and imaging examinations; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph)
1-3. Operation of the Central Physical Grade Assessment Deliberation Committee
2. Conduct a physical examination
3. Conduct outsourced testing at designated hospitals
4. Deleted <December 31, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 5. 신체검사와 관련한 자료 등 기록ㆍ유지 및 관리
rows.text_en: 5. Recording, maintenance, and management of materials, etc. related to physical examinations

rows.source_ko: 5의2. 신체검사 관련 의료기술 분야 교육에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5-2. Matters concerning education in the field of medical technology related to physical examinations

rows.source_ko: 6. 그 밖에 병무청장이 지정하는 신체검사에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Other matters concerning physical examinations designated by the Administrator of the Military Manpower Administration
[Title amended Dec. 30, 2022]
Chapter 4 Military Service Civil Affairs Counseling Center

rows.source_ko: 제11조(병무민원상담소) ① 병무민원상담소장은 의료기술사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Military Service Civil Affairs Counseling Center) ① The head of the Military Service Civil Affairs Counseling Center shall be appointed from among Medical Technology Officers, Computer Science Officers, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officers, or Administrative Officers.
② The Director of the Military Service Civil Affairs Counseling Center shall be responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 전화를 통한 병무 관련 민원에 대한 상담
rows.text_en: 1. Consultation on military service-related inquiries via telephone
2. Tasks related to automated telephone military service consultation

rows.source_ko: 3. 인터넷 및 서면으로 접수된 병무 관련 민원에 대한 상담 및 회신
rows.text_en: 3. Consultation and response to civil complaints regarding military service received via the internet and in writing
4. Military service consultation for visiting petitioners

rows.source_ko: 5. 제1호, 제3호 및 제4호에 따른 상담사례의 데이터베이스 구축 및 제도개선사항 수집
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment of a database of counseling cases and collection of institutional improvement matters pursuant to Subparagraphs 1, 3, and 4
6. General Affairs, Documents, Security, Personnel, and Official Seal Management
7. Matters concerning budget, accounting, and supplies
8. Establishment of work plan for the Military Service Civil Affairs Counseling Center
[Wholly Amended Dec. 19, 2023]
Chapter 5 Local Military Service Offices

rows.source_ko: 제12조(지방병무청장) ① 지방병무청장(경남지방병무청장 및 제주지방병무청장은 제외한다)은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 각각 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Heads of Regional Military Manpower Administrations) ① Heads of regional military manpower administrations (excluding the Heads of the Gyeongnam and Jeju Regional Military Manpower Administrations) shall be appointed as general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, provided that the job grade of each position shall be Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008>

rows.source_ko: ② 경남지방병무청장 및 제주지방병무청장은 각각 과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. 다만, 경남지방병무청장은 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제27조제3항에 따라 상호이체하여 배정ㆍ운영하는 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보할 수 있다. <개정 2009. 4. 8., 2009. 6. 25., 2013. 3. 23., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Directors of the Gyeongnam Regional Military Manpower Administration and the Jeju Regional Military Manpower Administration shall each be appointed as Senior Secretary for Science and Technology or Senior Secretary. However, the Director of the Gyeongnam Regional Military Manpower Administration may be appointed as a Deputy Director General, Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, or Senior Secretary assigned and operated through mutual transfer pursuant to Article 27, Paragraph 3 of the General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies. <Amended Apr. 8, 2009; Jun. 25, 2009; Mar. 23, 2013; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제13조(병역판정관) 병역판정관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2016. 11. 29., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Military Service Adjudication Officer) Military Service Adjudication Officers shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary. <Amended Nov. 29, 2016; Aug. 30, 2023>

[Wholly Amended Apr. 8, 2009]
[Title Amended Nov. 29, 2016]

rows.source_ko: 제14조(병무지청장) 인천병무지청장ㆍ경기북부병무지청장 및 강원영동병무지청장은 각각 과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. 다만, 인천병무지청장은 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제27조제3항에 따라 상호이체하여 배정ㆍ운영하는 부이사관 또는 서기관으로 보할 수 있다. <개정 2009. 6. 25., 2013. 3. 23., 2015. 5. 26., 2019. 2. 26., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Heads of Military Manpower Branch Offices) The Heads of the Incheon, Gyeonggi Northern, and Gangwon Yeongdong Military Manpower Branch Offices shall each be appointed as Senior Secretary for Science and Technology or Senior Secretary. However, the Head of the Incheon Military Manpower Branch Officemay be appointed as a Deputy Director General or Senior Secretary assigned and operated through mutual transfer pursuant to Article 27, Paragraph 3 of the General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies . <Amended June 25, 2009; March 23, 2013; May 26, 2015; February 26, 2019; August 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제15조(지방병무청에 두는 보조기관 및 보좌기관) ① 지방병무청(서울지방병무청ㆍ강원지방병무청ㆍ충북지방병무청 및 전북지방병무청은 제외한다)에 운영지원과ㆍ병역판정검사과ㆍ현역입영과ㆍ동원관리과ㆍ사회복무과ㆍ복무관리과 및 고객지원과를 둔다. 다만, 대구ㆍ경북지방병무청 및 경인지방병무청에는 병역조사과를 더 두고, 경남지방병무청에는 복무관리과를 두지 아니하며, 제주지방병무청에는 운영지원과 및 병역관리과만을 둔다. <개정 2009. 4. 8., 2013. 10. 4., 2015. 5. 26., 2016. 8. 29., 2016. 11. 29., 2017. 2. 28., 2020. 2. 25., 2023. 12. 19.>
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Auxiliary and Advisory Agencies in Regional Military Manpower Administrations) ① Regional Military Manpower Administrations (excluding the Seoul, Gangwon, Chungbuk, and Jeonbuk Regional Military Manpower Administrations) shall have the Operations Support Division, Military Service Judgment Examination Division, Active Duty Enlistment Division, Mobilization Management Division, Social Service Division, Service Management Division, and Customer Support Division. However, the Daegu, Gyeongbuk, and Gyeongin Regional Military Manpower Administrations shall additionally have the Military Service Investigation Division; the Gyeongnam Regional Military Manpower Administration shall not have the Service Management Division; and the Jeju Regional Military Manpower Administration shall have only the Operations Support Division and the Military Service Management Division. <Amended Apr. 8, 2009; Oct. 4, 2013; May 26, 2015; Aug. 29, 2016; Nov. 29, 2016; Feb. 28, 2017; Feb. 25, 2020; Dec. 19, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 서울지방병무청에 운영지원과ㆍ병역자원입영국 및 동원사회복무국을 둔다. <신설 2020. 2. 25., 2023. 12. 19.>
rows.text_en: ② The Seoul Regional Military Manpower Administration shall establish the Operations Support Division, the Military Service Resources and Enlistment Bureau, and the Mobilization Social Service Bureau. <Newly established Feb. 25, 2020; Dec. 19, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 서울지방병무청 병역자원입영국에 병역자원과ㆍ병역판정검사과ㆍ병역조사과ㆍ현역입영과 및 병역진로설계과를 두고, 동원사회복무국에 동원계획과ㆍ동원훈련과ㆍ사회복무과ㆍ복무관리과ㆍ산업지원과 및 고객지원과를 둔다. <개정 2023. 12. 19.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Military Service Resources Enlistment Bureau of the Seoul Regional Military Manpower Administration shall have the Military Service Resources Division, the Military Service Judgment Examination Division, the Military Service Investigation Division, the Active Duty Enlistment Division, and the Military Service Career Planning Division; and the Mobilization and Social Service Bureau shall have the Mobilization Planning Division, the Mobilization Training Division, the Social Service Division, the Service Management Division, the Industrial Support Division, and the Customer Support Division. <Amended Dec. 19, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ④ 강원지방병무청ㆍ충북지방병무청 및 전북지방병무청에 운영지원과ㆍ병역판정입영과ㆍ동원관리과ㆍ사회복무과 및 고객지원과를 둔다. <신설 2023. 12. 19.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Gangwon, Chungbuk, and Jeonbuk Regional Military Manpower Administrations shall have the Operations Support Division, the Military Service Judgment and Enlistment Division, the Mobilization Management Division, the Social Service Division, and the Customer Support Division. <Newly established Dec. 19, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 각 과장은 의료기술사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보하되, 다음 각 호의 과장은 다음 각 호의 구분에 따라 보한다. <개정 2017. 9. 4., 2017. 12. 29., 2020. 2. 25., 2020. 6. 9., 2022. 2. 22., 2023. 8. 30., 2023. 12. 19., 2024. 2. 27.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ Each Division Head shall be appointed from among Medical Technology Officers, Computer Science Officers, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officers, or Administrative Officers; provided, however, that the Division Heads referred to in each of the following subparagraphs shall be appointed in accordance with the classifications set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Sep. 4, 2017; Dec. 29, 2017; Feb. 25, 2020; Jun. 9, 2020; Feb. 22, 2022; Aug. 30, 2023; Dec. 19, 2023; Feb. 27, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 운영지원과장: 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ의료기술사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관. 다만, 경남지방병무청 및 제주지방병무청은 의료기술사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: 1. Head of Operations Support Division: Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Medical Technology Officer, Computer Science Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, or Administrative Officer. However, the Gyeongnam Regional Military Manpower Administration and the Jeju Regional Military Manpower Administration shall appoint Medical Technology Officer, Computer Science Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, or Administrative Officer.

rows.source_ko: 2. 병역판정검사과장: 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ의료기술사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관. 다만, 경남지방병무청은 의료기술사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: 2. Head of Military Service Judgment Examination Division: Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Medical Technology Officer, Computer Science Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, or Administrative Officer. However, the Gyeongnam Regional Military Manpower Administration shall appoint a Medical Technology Officer, Computer Science Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, or Administrative Officer.

rows.source_ko: 3. 고객지원과장: 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ의료기술사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관. 다만, 강원지방병무청, 충북지방병무청, 전북지방병무청 및 경남지방병무청은 의료기술사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: 3. Head of Customer Support Division: Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Medical Technology Officer, Computer Science Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, or Administrative Officer. However, the Gangwon Regional Military Manpower Administration, Chungbuk Regional Military Manpower Administration, Jeonbuk Regional Military Manpower Administration, and Gyeongnam Regional Military Manpower Administration shall appoint a Medical Technology Officer, Computer Science Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, or Administrative Officer.

4. Head of Military Service Investigation Division: Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, Medical Technology Officer, Computer Science Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, or Administrative Officer

5. Head of Military Service Judgment and Enlistment Division: Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, Medical Technology Officer, Computer Science Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, or Administrative Officer
Article 16 (Operations Support Division) The Head of the Operations Support Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Oct. 22, 2009; Mar. 30, 2018>
1. Security
2. Management of Official Seals and Official Seal Registers
3. Planning Coordination and Review Analysis
4. General Affairs, Personnel, Documentation, Accounting, Maintenance, Public Relations, and Auditing

rows.source_ko: 5. 공직자 등의 병역사항 신고 및 공개
rows.text_en: 5. Reporting and Disclosure of Military Service Details by Public Officials, etc.
5-2. Deleted <December 19, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 6. 기록관의 운영 및 기록물 관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the operation of the archives and the management of records

rows.source_ko: 7. 그 밖에 청내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 아니하는 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other divisions within the office

Article 17 (Military Service Judgment Examination Division) The Head of the Military Service Judgment Examination Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Nov. 29, 2016; Dec. 30, 2022>
1. Investigation of persons subject to transfer to the military reserve
2. Investigation and Management of Subjects to Military Service Examination
3. Implementation of Military Service Judgment Examination
4. Postponement of military service physical examination
5. Management of currently enrolled students granted military service deferment
6. Service Management of Doctors Specializing in Military Service Examination
7. Disposition of military service exemption, etc. upon application
8. Resource Management of Overseas Migrants
9. Implementation of the Enlistment Judgment Examination
[Title amended Nov. 29, 2016]

Article 18 (Active Duty Enlistment Division) The Head of the Active Duty Enlistment Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 8, 2011; Nov. 29, 2016; Jan. 22, 2018; Jul. 1, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 현역병입영대상자 및 귀가처분을 받은 사람의 관리
rows.text_en: 1. Management of persons subject to conscription for active duty and persons sent home

rows.source_ko: 2. 현역병의 입영, 입영연기 및 입영일의 연기
rows.text_en: 2. Enlistment of active duty soldiers, deferment of enlistment, and postponement of enlistment date
3. Reduction of active duty service period due to family circumstances
4. Management and Enlistment of Medical, Legal, Chaplain, and Veterinary Officer Candidates

rows.source_ko: 5. 학군 군간부후보생 및 군 가산복무 지원금 지급 대상자의 병적관리
rows.text_en: 5. Military record management of ROTC officer candidates and recipients of additional military service support funds

rows.source_ko: 6. 치안업무보조 의무경찰대원 및 소방업무보조 의무소방원의 관리
rows.text_en: 6. Management of Conscripted Police Officers Assisting in Public Security and Conscripted Firefighters Assisting in Firefighting
7. Management of Candidates for Enrollment as Basic Branch Officers
8. Selection and Enlistment of Personnel Subject to Call-up for Full-time Reserve Service
9. Prevention and Handling of Military Service Evasion (including disappearance)

rows.source_ko: 10. 전시ㆍ사변 또는 동원령이 선포된 때의 지방병무사범방지대책위원회의 운영
rows.text_en: 10. Operation of the Local Military Service Offenses Prevention Committee when a war, armed conflict, or mobilization order is declared

rows.source_ko: 11. 현역병입영대상자의 입영판정검사 통지, 연기 및 기피자 처리
rows.text_en: 11. Notification of enlistment eligibility examination, deferment, and handling of evaders for active duty conscription candidates
12. Enlistment of Active Duty Applicants
13. Recruitment and Promotion of Active Duty Applicants
14. Selection of Active Duty Applicants

rows.source_ko: 15. 현역병지원자의 입영판정검사 통지, 연기 및 기피자 처리
rows.text_en: 15. Notification of enlistment eligibility examination, deferment, and handling of evaders for active duty applicants

Article 19 (Mobilization Management Division) The Head of the Mobilization Management Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Dec. 4, 2013; Jan. 6, 2015; Nov. 29, 2016; Nov. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 1. 현역복무 또는 사회복무요원 소집복무를 마친 예비역 및 보충역의 관리
rows.text_en: 1. Management of reservists and supplementary personnel who have completed active duty or social service duty

rows.source_ko: 2. 현역복무 또는 사회복무요원 소집복무를 마친 예비역ㆍ보충역의 병역처분 변경 및 병역면제
rows.text_en: 2. Change of military service disposition and military service exemption for reservists and supplementary service personnel who have completed active duty or social service duty

rows.source_ko: 제39조(서울지방병무청 및 경인지방병무청의 병역판정검사운영관) ① 서울지방병무청 및 경인지방병무청에 두는 각 병역판정검사운영관은 의료기술사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2016. 11. 29., 2017. 9. 4., 2022. 2. 22., 2023. 8. 30., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 39 (Military Service Judgment Examination Operations Officers of the Seoul and Gyeongin Regional Military Manpower Administrations) ① Each Military Service Judgment Examination Operations Officer assigned to the Seoul and Gyeongin Regional Military Manpower Administrations shall be appointed from among Medical Technology Officers, Computer Science Officers, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officers, or Administrative Officers. <Amended Nov. 29, 2016; Sep. 4, 2017; Feb. 22, 2022; Aug. 30, 2023; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 병역판정검사운영관은 다음 사항에 관하여 지방병무청장을 보좌한다. <개정 2016. 11. 29.>
rows.text_en: ② The Officer for Military Service Judgment Examination Operations assists the Head of the Regional Military Manpower Administration with respect to the following matters. <Amended Nov. 29, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 1. 병역판정검사 및 이를 받은 사람의 병역처분 등
rows.text_en: 1. Military service physical examination and military service disposition of persons who have undergone the examination, etc.
2. Physical examination of those sent home or applicants for a change in military service disposition
3. Other matters designated by the head of the regional military manpower office
[Title amended Dec. 30, 2025]

rows.source_ko: 제39조의2(인천병무지청에 두는 과) ① 인천병무지청에 운영지원과ㆍ병역판정검사과ㆍ현역입영과ㆍ동원관리과ㆍ사회복무과ㆍ복무관리과 및 고객지원과를 두되, 각 과장은 의료기술사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2016. 11. 29., 2017. 9. 4., 2017. 12. 29., 2022. 2. 22., 2023. 8. 30., 2023. 12. 19.>
rows.text_en: Article 39-2 (Divisions in the Incheon Military Manpower Office) ① The Incheon Military Manpower Office shall have the Operations Support Division, Military Service Judgment Examination Division, Active Duty Enlistment Division, Mobilization Management Division, Social Service Division, Service Management Division, and Customer Support Division; provided that the head of each division shall be appointed from among Medical Technology Officers, Computer Science Officers, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officers, or Administrative Officers. <Amended Nov. 29, 2016; Sep. 4, 2017; Dec. 29, 2017; Feb. 22, 2022; Aug. 30, 2023; Dec. 19, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 운영지원과장은 제16조에 규정된 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Head of Operations Support Division shall be responsible for the matters stipulated in Article 16 .

rows.source_ko: ③ 병역판정검사과장은 제17조에 규정된 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2016. 11. 29.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Military Service Judgment Examination Division shall be responsible for the matters prescribed in Article 17. <Amended Nov. 29, 2016>

rows.source_ko: ④ 현역입영과장은 제18조에 규정된 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2021. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Active Duty Enlistment Division shall be responsible for the matters prescribed in Article 18. <Amended July 1, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 동원관리과장은 제19조에 규정된 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Mobilization Management Division shall be responsible for the matters stipulated in Article 19 .

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 사회복무과장은 제20조에 규정된 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2023. 12. 19.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Social Service Division shall be responsible for the matters prescribed in Article 20. <Amended Dec. 19, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 복무관리과장은 제21조에 규정된 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2023. 12. 19.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the Service Management Division shall be responsible for the matters prescribed in Article 21. <Newly added Dec. 19, 2023>
⑧ The Head of Customer Support Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jul. 1, 2021; Dec. 19, 2023>
1. Matters stipulated in Article 22
2. Matters concerning the establishment and operation of the Incheon Airport Military Service Civil Affairs Center
[This Article Newly Inserted May 26, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제40조(경기북부병무지청에 두는 과) ① 경기북부병무지청에 운영지원과ㆍ병역판정검사과ㆍ현역입영과ㆍ동원관리과ㆍ사회복무과 및 고객지원과를 두되, 각 과장은 의료기술사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2009. 4. 8., 2013. 10. 4., 2016. 11. 29., 2017. 2. 28., 2017. 9. 4., 2017. 12. 29., 2022. 2. 22., 2023. 8. 30., 2023. 12. 19.>
rows.text_en: Article 40 (Divisions in the Gyeonggi Northern Military Manpower Office) ① The Gyeonggi Northern Military Manpower Office shall have the Operations Support Division, Military Service Judgment Examination Division, Active Duty Enlistment Division, Mobilization Management Division, Social Service Division, and Customer Support Division; provided that the head of each division shall be appointed from among Medical Technology Officers, Computer Science Officers, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officers, or Administrative Officers. <Amended Apr. 8, 2009; Oct. 4, 2013; Nov. 29, 2016; Feb. 28, 2017; Sep. 4, 2017; Dec. 29, 2017; Feb. 22, 2022; Aug. 30, 2023; Dec. 19, 2023>

rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Military Service Judgment Examination Division shall be responsible for the matters prescribed in Article 17. <Amended Nov. 29, 2016>

rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Active Duty Enlistment Division shall be responsible for the matters prescribed in Article 18. <Amended Feb. 28, 2017; Jul. 1, 2021>

rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of Customer Support Division shall be responsible for the matters prescribed in Article 22. <Newly added Feb. 28, 2017; Jul. 1, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 제41조(강원영동병무지청에 두는 과) ① 강원영동병무지청에 운영지원과 및 병역관리과를 두되, 각 과장은 의료기술사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관 또는 행정사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2013. 10. 4., 2017. 9. 4., 2017. 12. 29., 2022. 2. 22., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 41 (Divisions in the Gangwon Yeongdong Military Manpower Office) ① The Gangwon Yeongdong Military Manpower Office shall have an Operations Support Division and a Military Service Management Division; provided that the heads of each division shall be appointed from among Medical Technology Officers, Computer Science Officers, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officers, or Administrative Officers. <Amended Oct. 4, 2013; Sep. 4, 2017; Dec. 29, 2017; Feb. 22, 2022; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 운영지원과장은 제16조, 제18조제12호부터 제15호까지 및 제22조에 규정된 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2021. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② The Head of the Operations Support Division shall be responsible for the matters prescribed in Article 16 , Article 18 (Subparagraphs 12 through 15) , and Article 22. <Amended July 1, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ③ 병역관리과장은 제17조, 제18조제1호부터 제11호까지 및 제19조부터 제21조까지에 규정된 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2016. 8. 29., 2021. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Military Service Management Division shall be responsible for the matters prescribed in Article 17 , Article 18 (Subparagraphs 1 through 11) , and Articles 19 through 21. <Amended Aug. 29, 2016; July 1, 2021>
Article 42 Deleted <October 4, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제43조(지방병무청 및 병무지청의 관할구역) 지방병무청의 관할구역은 별표 1과 같고, 병무지청의 관할구역은 별표 2와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 43 (Jurisdiction of Regional Military Manpower Administrations and Military Manpower Branch Offices) The jurisdiction of regional military manpower administrations is as set forth in Table 1 , and the jurisdiction of military manpower branch offices is as set forth in Table 2 .
Chapter 5-2 Alternative Service Review Committee <Newly established June 9, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 제43조의2(대체역 심사위원회) ① 대체역 심사위원회의 위원장 및 상임위원은 고위공무원단에 속하는 임기제공무원으로 보하되, 위원장의 직무등급은 가등급으로, 상임위원의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 43-2 (Alternative Service Review Committee) ① The Chairperson and Standing Members of the Alternative Service Review Committee shall be appointed as fixed-term public officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service, provided that the Chairperson’s job grade is Grade A and the Standing Members’ job grade is Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 대체역 심사위원회 사무국에 심사기획과 및 심사운영과를 두되, 각 과장은 과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2022. 12. 30., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Secretariat of the Alternative Service Review Committee shall establish a Review Planning Division and a Review Operations Division, and the heads of each division shall be appointed as Senior Secretary for Science and Technology or Senior Secretary. <Amended Dec. 30, 2022; Aug. 30, 2023>
③ The Head of the Review Planning Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Dec. 30, 2022; Dec. 31, 2024>
1. Management of general affairs, documents, security, personnel, and official seals

rows.source_ko: 2. 예산ㆍ회계ㆍ결산 및 물품 관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning budget, accounting, settlement of accounts, and goods management
3. Maintenance and management of computer, telecommunications, and broadcasting equipment and meeting management systems

rows.source_ko: 4. 대체역 심사제도에 관한 정책 수립 및 기획
rows.text_en: 4. Policy Formulation and Planning Regarding the Alternative Service Screening System

rows.source_ko: 5. 대체역 심사위원회 심사기준의 정립 및 관련 규정의 제ㆍ개정
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment of Review Criteria for the Alternative Service Review Committee and Enactment and Amendment of Related Regulations

rows.source_ko: 6. 대체역 심사위원회의 회의 운영 및 의결서ㆍ회의록 작성
rows.text_en: 6. Operation of Alternative Service Review Committee meetings and preparation of resolutions and minutes

rows.source_ko: 7. 대체역 심사 관련 행정심판ㆍ소송에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning administrative appeals and litigation related to alternative service screening
8. Civil Complaint Consultation Regarding Alternative Service Screening

rows.source_ko: 9. 그 밖에 사무국 내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other divisions within the Secretariat
④ The Head of the Review Operations Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Dec. 30, 2022; Dec. 31, 2024>
1. Receipt of applications and assignment of alternative service

rows.source_ko: 2. 사전심사 위원회의 구성 및 기록관리 등 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the operation of the preliminary screening committee, including composition and record management

rows.source_ko: 3. 대체역 편입신청에 대한 현장 확인, 대면 조사 등 사실조사 계획 수립ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment and operation of plans for fact-finding investigations, such as on-site verification and face-to-face interviews, regarding applications for alternative service.

rows.source_ko: 4. 대체역 심사위원회 안건 상정 및 심사 지원
rows.text_en: 4. Submission of agenda items to the Alternative Service Review Committee and support for review
5. Preparation and Notification of Alternative Service Review Committee Review Decision
6. Civil Complaint Consultation Regarding Alternative Service Screening
[This Article Newly Inserted June 9, 2020]
Chapter 6. Staffing Levels of Public Officials

rows.source_ko: 제44조(병무청에 두는 공무원의 정원) ①병무청에 두는 공무원의 정원은 별표 3과 같다. 다만, 「병무청과 그 소속기관 직제」 제26조제1항 단서에 따라 별표 3에 따른 총정원의 10퍼센트를 넘지 않는 범위에서 따로 정하는 공무원의 정원은 별표 3의2와 같다. <개정 2009. 6. 25., 2017. 12. 29., 2018. 2. 22., 2021. 1. 5., 2021. 7. 1., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 44 (Standard Quota of Public Officials in the Military Manpower Administration) ① The standard quota of public officials in the Military Manpower Administration shall be as set forth in Table 3. However, the standard quota of public officials separately determined pursuant to the proviso to Article 26, Paragraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Military Manpower Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies,” within a range not exceeding 10 percent of the total standard quota set forth in Table 3 , shall be as set forth in Table 3-2 . <Amended June 25, 2009; December 29, 2017; February 22, 2018; January 5, 2021; July 1, 2021; August 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 병무청에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 홍보업무를 담당하는 1명(4급 또는 5급 1명), 정보화업무를 담당하는 2명(5급 1명, 6급 1명), 특별사법경찰관의 업무를 담당하는 7명(6급 2명, 7급 5명), 행정심판ㆍ소송, 법제 업무를 담당하는 1명(5급 1명) 및 그 밖의 정원 1명(3급 또는 4급 1명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용할 수 있다. <신설 2009. 6. 25., 2012. 5. 18., 2013. 12. 12., 2019. 2. 26., 2020. 6. 9., 2020. 11. 30., 2023. 8. 30., 2023. 12. 19.>
rows.text_en: ② Among the authorized number of public officials in the Military Manpower Administration, one person in charge of public relations (one person of Grade 4 or 5), two people in charge of informatization (one person of Grade 5 and one person of Grade 6), seven people in charge of special judicial police officer duties (two people of Grade 6 and five people of Grade 7), one person in charge of administrative appeals, litigation, and legislative affairs (one person of Grade 5), and one person in the other authorized number (one person of Grade 3 or 4) may be appointed as a fixed-term public official. <Newly added June 25, 2009; May 18, 2012; December 12, 2013; Feb. 26, 2019; June 9, 2020; Nov. 30, 2020; Aug. 30, 2023; Dec. 19, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 병무청에 두는 공무원 정원 중 공공데이터 관련 업무를 담당하는 1명(5급 1명), 디지털 홍보 업무를 담당하는 1명(6급 1명), 정보보호ㆍ보안을 담당하는 1명(7급 1명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용한다. <신설 2019. 2. 26., 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ Among the authorized number of civil servants in the Military Manpower Administration, one person responsible for public data-related duties (Grade 5), one person responsible for digital public relations duties (Grade 6), and one person responsible for information protection and security (Grade 7) shall be appointed as fixed-term civil servants. <Newly added Feb. 26, 2019; Dec. 30, 2025>

Article 45 (Standard Quota of Public Officials in Affiliated Agencies) ① The standard quota of public officials in the Social Service Training Center shall be as set forth in Attached Table 3-3 . <Newly added Mar. 2, 2016; Feb. 28, 2017; Dec. 29, 2017; Feb. 22, 2018; Mar. 30, 2018; Dec. 30, 2019; Jan. 5, 2021; Feb. 25, 2021; Dec. 14, 2021; Aug. 30, 2023; Jul. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 중앙병역판정검사소에 두는 공무원의 정원은 별표 4와 같다. <개정 2016. 3. 2., 2022. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The authorized number of public officials at the Central Military Service Examination Center is as set forth in Attached Table 4. <Amended Mar. 2, 2016; Dec. 30, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ③ 병무민원상담소에 두는 공무원의 정원은 별표 5와 같다. 다만, 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제29조제2항 및 「병무청과 그 소속기관 직제」제27조제1항 단서에 따라 총정원의 10퍼센트를 넘지 않는 범위에서 따로 정하는 공무원의 정원은 별표 5의2와 같다. <개정 2016. 3. 2., 2018. 2. 22., 2019. 12. 30., 2021. 1. 5., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ The authorized number of public officials assigned to the Military Service Civil Complaint Counseling Center is as set forth in Attached Table 5. However, the authorized number of public officials separately determined within a range not exceeding 10 percent of the total authorized number, pursuant to Article 29 , Paragraph 2 of the “ General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies ” and the proviso to Article 27, Paragraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Military Manpower Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies,” is as set forth in Attached Table 5-2 . <Amended Mar. 2, 2016; Feb. 22, 2018; Dec. 30, 2019; Jan. 5, 2021; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 별표 3, 별표 3의2, 별표 6(행정서기 12명의 증원, 행정서기보 3명의 증원, 전산서기보 또는 통신서기보 1명의 증원 및 기능직 16명의 감축 부분만 해당한다) 및 별표 6의2(행정서기 12명의 증원, 행정서기보 3명의 증원, 전산서기보 또는 통신서기보 1명의 증원 및 기능직 16명의 감축 부분만 해당한다)의 개정규정은 2010년 1월 1일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. rows.source_ko: 제2조(사무직렬 기능직공무원 정원조정에 따른 특례) 별표 3, 별표 3의2, 별표 6 및 별표 6의2의 개정규정에 따라 증원(별표 6의 개정규정에 따른 의료기술주사 5명 및 의료기술주사보 3명의 증원과 별표 6의2의 개정규정에 따른 의료기술주사 5명 및 의료기술주사보 3명의 증원은 제외한다)되는 일반직공무원 정원 22명(행정서기 17명, 전산서기 또는 통신서기 1명, 행정서기보 3명 및 전산서기보 또는 통신서기보 1명)은 대통령령 제21717호 공무원임용령 일부개정령 부칙 제2조에 따라 충원하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Special provisions regarding the adjustment of the number of technical civil servants in the administrative series) The 22 general civil servant  positions (17 administrative clerks, 1 computer clerk or communications clerk, 3 administrative assistant clerks, and 1 computer assistant clerk or communications assistant clerk) that are increased pursuant to the amended provisions of Annex 3, Annex 3-2, Annex 6, and Annex 6-2 (excluding the increase of 5 medical technology chief clerks and 3 medical technology assistant clerks pursuant to the amended provisions of Annex 6, and the increase of 5 medical technology chief clerks and 3 medical technology assistant clerks pursuant to the amended provisions of Annex 6-2) shall be filled in accordance with Article 2 of the Addenda to the Partial Amendment to the Public Officials Appointment Decree, Presidential Decree No. 21717.

rows.text_en: ② The Enforcement Rules for the Organization of the Military Manpower Administration and its Affiliated Agencies are partially amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제9조제3항제7호 중 “감시ㆍ보호ㆍ봉사 등 사회서비스 업무”를 “사회복지, 보건ㆍ의료, 교육ㆍ문화, 환경ㆍ안전 등 사회서비스”로 한다.

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Special provisions regarding the adjustment of the number of technical civil servants in the  administrative series) The 24 general civil servant positions that are increased pursuant to the amended provisions of Annex 3, Annex 3-2, Annex 4, Annex 6, and Annex 6-2 (applicable only to the increase of 18 administrative clerks, the increase of 5 assistant administrative clerks, the increase of 1 computer assistant or telecommunications assistant clerk, and the reduction of 24 technical positions) shall be filled in accordance with Article 2 of the Addenda to the Partial Amendment to the Public Officials Appointment Decree, Presidential Decree No. 21717.

rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, the amended provisions of Article 45, Paragraph 4 shall enter into force on July 1, 2012.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(사무직렬 기능직공무원의 정원조정에 관한 특례) 이 규칙 시행에 따라 증원되는 일반직공무원 정원 28명(행정주사보 1명, 행정서기 22명, 전산서기 또는 통신서기 1명, 행정서기보 3명, 전산서기보 또는 통신서기보 1명)은 대통령령 제21717호 공무원임용령 일부개정령 부칙 제2조에 따라 충원하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Special provisions regarding the adjustment of the number of technical civil servants in the administrative series)  The 28 general civil servant positions to be increased pursuant to the enforcement of this rule (1 administrative assistant, 22 administrative clerks, 1 computer clerk or communications clerk, 3 administrative assistant clerks, and 1 computer assistant clerk or communications assistant clerk) shall be filled in accordance with Article 2 of the Addenda to the Partial Amendment to the Public Officials Appointment Decree, Presidential Decree No. 21717.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(사무직렬 기능직공무원의 정원감축에 따른 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행으로 감축되는 기능직공무원 정원 28명(기능 9급 2명 및 기능 10급 26명)에 해당하는 기능직공무원의 초과현원이 있는 경우에는 2012년 1월 1일까지 증원되는 일반직공무원 정원 28명(행정주사보 1명, 행정서기 22명, 전산서기 또는 통신서기 1명, 행정서기보 3명, 전산서기보 또는 통신서기보 1명)의 정원을 대체하여 있는 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Following the Reduction of Quotas for Technical Civil Servants in the Administrative Series) If  there is an excess number of technical civil servants corresponding to the 28 technical civil servant quotas (2 Grade 9 and 26 Grade 10) reduced by the enforcement of this Rule, such excess personnel shall be deemed to have replaced the 28 general civil servant quotas (1 Assistant Administrative Officer, 22 Administrative Clerks, 1 Computer Clerk or Communications Clerk, 3 Assistant Administrative Clerks, and 1 Assistant Computer Clerk or Communications Clerk) increased until January 1, 2012.

rows.text_en: ② The Enforcement Rules for the Organization of the Military Manpower Administration and its Affiliated Agencies are partially amended as follows.
In Article 8, Paragraph 5, Subparagraph 8, “public service worker” shall be changed to “social service worker.”

rows.source_ko: 제2조(정원에 관한 경과조치) 대통령령 제24970호 병무청과 그 소속기관 직제 일부개정령 시행에 따른 초과현원으로서 이 규칙에 따른 정원을 초과하는 현원 19명(5급 1명, 6급 2명, 7급 5명, 8급 6명, 9급 5명)은 그 초과된 현원이 이 규칙에 따른 정원과 일치될 때까지 그에 상응하는 정원이 병무청과 그 소속기관에 따로 있는 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning Personnel Quotas) Where 19 personnel (1 Grade 5, 2 Grade 6, 5 Grade 7, 6 Grade 8, and 5 Grade 9) exceed the quota under these Rules as a result of the enforcement of Presidential Decree No. 24970, the Partial Amendment to the Organization of the Military Manpower Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies, a separate quota corresponding to the excess personnel shall be deemed to exist in the Military Manpower Administration and its affiliated agencies until the number of personnel conforms to the quota under these Rules.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(기능직 폐지에 따른 정원 조정에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행으로 기능직공무원 정원을 감축하여 증원되는 일반직공무원 정원 중 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제26조제2항 및 제3항에 따라 통합ㆍ운영하던 정원이 있는 경우에, 그 통합ㆍ운영하던 직급에 근속승진 임용된 공무원에 대해서는 해당 직급에 재직하는 동안에는 별표 3, 별표 3의2, 별표 4, 별표 6 및 별표 6의2의 개정규정에도 불구하고 그 정원이 병무청과 그 소속기관에 따로 있는 것으로 보고, 그에 해당하는 종전 직급의 정원은 감축된 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Concerning the Adjustment of Personnel Quotas Following the Abolition of Functional Positions)  In cases where there are personnel quotas for general civil servants that are increased by reducing the personnel quota for functional civil servants due to the enforcement of this Rule, and which were previously integrated and operated pursuant to Article 26, Paragraphs 2 and 3 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies,” for civil servants appointed by promotion based on seniority to the integrated and operated ranks, notwithstanding the amended provisions of Annex 3, Annex 3-2, Annex 4, Annex 6, and Annex 6-2, such personnel quotas shall be deemed to exist separately within the Military Manpower Administration and its affiliated agencies while they are serving in the relevant ranks, and the personnel quota for the corresponding former ranks shall be deemed to have been reduced.
ADDENDA <Ministry of National Defense Decree No. 813, Dec. 24, 2013>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning Personnel Quotas)  In the event that there is an excess number of personnel corresponding to the personnel quota of one person (one Assistant Security Clerk) for the security series of officials in agencies under the Military Manpower Administration that is reduced due to the enforcement of this Rule, the personnel quota corresponding to such excess personnel shall be deemed to exist separately in the agencies under the Military Manpower Administration until the number of personnel matches the personnel quota pursuant to this Rule.

rows.text_en: In Article 7, Paragraph 2, “Conscription Examination Division” shall be changed to “Military Service Judgment Examination Division”; in the part other than the subparagraphs of Paragraph 4 of the same article, “Head of Conscription Examination Division” shall be changed to “Head of Military Service Judgment Examination Division”; in Subparagraphs 1 and 3 of the same paragraph, “Conscription Examination” shall be changed to “Military Service Judgment Examination” respectively; in Subparagraph 4 of the same paragraph, “Conscription Examination Equipment” shall be changed to “Military Service Judgment Examination Equipment”; in Subparagraph 9 of the same paragraph, “Doctor in Charge of Conscription Examination” shall be changed to “Doctor in Charge of Military Service Judgment Examination”; in Subparagraph 11 of the same paragraph, “First National Service” shall be changed to “Military Service Preparation Service” and “Second National Service” shall be changed to “Wartime Labor Service”; in Subparagraph 12 of the same paragraph, “Second National Service” shall be changed to “Wartime Labor Service”; in Subparagraphs 14 and 15 of the same paragraph, “First National Service” shall be changed to “Military Service Preparation Service” respectively; and in Subparagraph 17 of the same paragraph “Subject to conscription examination” shall be changed to “subject to military service judgment examination,” “conscription examination” in subparagraph 2 of Paragraph 5 of the same Article shall be changed to “military service judgment examination,” and “medical certificate for military service” in subparagraph 3 of the same Paragraph shall be changed to “medical certificate for military service.”

rows.source_ko: 제3조(총액인건비제로 상향 조정한 직급의 존속기한) 종전의 국방부령 제975호 병무청과 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙 일부개정령 부칙 제2조제2항에 따른 정원으로서 별표 6의2의 개정규정에 따라 조정된 인원을 제외한 51명(행정주사 10명, 의료기술주사 1명, 전산주사 또는 방송통신주사 1명, 행정주사보 17명, 의료기술주사보 1명, 전산주사보 또는 방송통신주사보 1명, 행정서기 18명, 의료기술서기 1명, 전산서기 또는 방송통신서기 1명)은 2026년 12월 31일까지 존속하며, 2027년 1월 1일 이후 그에 해당하는 정원은 각각 행정주사보 10명, 의료기술주사보 1명, 전산주사보 또는 방송통신주사보 1명, 행정서기 17명, 의료기술서기 1명, 전산서기 또는 방송통신서기 1명, 행정서기보 18명, 의료기술서기보 1명, 전산서기보 또는 방송통신서기보 1명으로 본다. <개정 2020. 8. 14., 2022. 8. 26., 2024. 5. 14., 2026. 2. 19.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Duration of Positions Upgraded to the Total Personnel Cost System)  The 51 personnel (10 Administrative Assistants, 1 Medical Technology Assistant, 1 Computer Assistant or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Assistant, 17 Junior Administrative Assistants, 1 Junior Medical Technology Assistant, 1 Junior Computer Assistant or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Assistant, 18 Administrative Clerks, 1 Medical Technology Clerk, and 1 Computer Clerk or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Clerk) representing the authorized quota under Article 2, Paragraph 2 of the Addenda to the Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules of the Organizational Structure of the Military Manpower Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies (Former Ministry of National Defense Decree No. 975), excluding those adjusted in accordance with the amended provisions of Annex 6-2, shall remain in effect until December 31, 2026; and from January 1, 2027, the corresponding authorized quotas shall be deemed to be 10 Junior Administrative Assistants [행정주사보], 1 Junior Medical Technology Assistant [의료기술주사보], 1 Junior Computer Assistant or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Assistant [전산주사보 또는 방송통신주사보], 17 Administrative Clerks [행정서기], 1 Medical Technology Clerk [의료기술서기], 1 Computer Clerk or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Clerk [전산서기 또는 방송통신서기], 18 Assistant Administrative Clerks [행정서기보], 1 Assistant Medical Technology Clerk [의료기술서기보], and 1 Assistant Computer Clerk or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Clerk [전산서기보 또는 방송통신서기보]. <Amended Aug. 14, 2020; Aug. 26, 2022; May 14, 2024; Feb. 19, 2026>

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Organizations Newly Established Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① An Information Security Team newly established pursuant to Article 29 of the General Rules on the Organization and Staffing of Administrative Agencies under the enforcement of this Rule shall remain in existence until June 30, 2029. <Amended Dec. 19, 2023; Jun. 30, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 존속기한까지 정보보호팀장이 분장하는 사항에 관하여 특별한 규정을 두지 않는 경우에는 제1항에 따른 존속기한이 지난 날부터 정보보호팀장이 분장하는 사항은 정보기획과장이 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ② If no special provisions are made regarding the matters assigned by the Information Security Team Leader until the expiration date under Paragraph 1, the matters assigned by the Information Security Team Leader shall be assigned by the Head of the Information Planning Division from the day after the expiration date under Paragraph 1.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(총액인건비제로 상향 조정한 직급의 존속기한) 종전의 국방부령 제934호 병무청과 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙 일부개정령 부칙 제2조제2항에 따른 정원으로서, 이 규칙 시행으로 직급이 환원되는 정원 2명(행정주사보 2명)을 제외한 별표 3의2의 정원 7명(행정사무관 3명, 행정주사 3명, 행정주사보 1명)은 2026년 12월 31일까지 존속하며, 2027년 1월 1일 이후 그에 해당하는 정원은 각각 행정주사 3명, 행정주사보 3명, 행정서기 1명으로 본다. <개정 2022. 8. 26., 2024. 5. 14., 2026. 2. 19.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Ranks Upgraded under the Total Personnel Cost System) Excluding the two positions (two Junior Administrative Assistants [행정주사보]) whose grades revert upon the enforcement of these Rules, the seven positions in Attached Table 3-2 (three Administrative Officers [행정사무관], three Administrative Junior Officers [행정주사], and one Junior Administrative Assistant [행정주사보]) under Article 2, Paragraph 2 of the Addenda to the former Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules on the Organization of the Military Manpower Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies (Ministry of National Defense Decree No. 934) shall remain in effect until December 31, 2026. From January 1, 2027, the corresponding positions shall be deemed to be three Administrative Junior Officers [행정주사], three Junior Administrative Assistants [행정주사보], and one Administrative Clerk [행정서기], respectively. <Amended Aug. 26, 2022; May 14, 2024; Feb. 19, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(총액인건비제로 상향 조정한 직급의 존속기한) 이 규칙 시행으로 상향 조정되는 별표 6의2의 정원 26명(행정주사보 9명, 전산주사보 또는 방송통신주사보 1명, 행정서기 15명, 의료기술서기 1명)은 2026년 12월 31일까지 존속하며, 2027년 1월 1일 이후 그에 해당하는 정원은 별표 6의2의 정원 26명(행정서기 9명, 전산서기 또는 방송통신서기 1명, 행정서기보 15명, 의료기술서기보 1명)으로 본다. <개정 2025. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Duration of Positions Upgraded Under the Total Personnel Cost System) The authorized  quota of 26 positions (9 Assistant Administrative Officers, 1 Assistant Computer Officer or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, 15 Administrative Clerks, and 1 Medical Technology Clerk) specified in Annex 6-2, which is upgraded upon the enforcement of this Rule, shall remain in effect until December 31, 2026; and from January 1, 2027, the corresponding authorized quota shall be deemed to be the authorized quota of 26 positions (9 Administrative Clerks, 1 Computer Clerk or Broadcasting and Telecommunications Clerk, 15 Assistant Administrative Clerks, and 1 Assistant Medical Technology Clerk) specified in Annex 6-2. <Amended Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제4조(정원에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행으로 감축되는 임기제공무원으로 임용할 수 있는 정원 1명(9급 1명)에 해당하는 초과현원이 있는 경우에는 2023년 12월 31일까지 그 초과현원에 상응하는 정원이 지방병무청 및 병무지청에 따로 있는 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Transitional Measures Concerning Personnel Quotas)  If there is an excess number of personnel corresponding to the quota of one fixed-term public official (one Grade 9 official) that can be appointed due to the enforcement of this Rule, the quota corresponding to such excess personnel shall be deemed to exist separately in the Regional Military Manpower Administration and Military Manpower Branch Offices until December 31, 2023.

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning Quotas)  If there is an excess of personnel corresponding to the quota of 3 (2 Grade 5 and 1 Grade 6) of the Alternative Service Review Committee under the Military Manpower Administration that is reduced by the enforcement of this Rule, the corresponding quota shall be deemed to exist separately within the Alternative Service Review Committee under the Military Manpower Administration until the excess personnel matches the quota pursuant to this Rule.
